about: What a correct pipeline run on the harbor fixture produces. live_eval.py scores a run against this. Phrases compare lowercased, with backticks, braces, and backslashes removed and whitespace collapsed. Locations name a file and the anchor text on the cited line.

D1.what: gitAuthArgs substring host match sends the service token to any host; cloneRepo is the caller

D2.what: Store.deleteRepo lets a non-admin delete system rows; the route relies on it

D3.what: unvalidated repository id escapes REPOS_DIR; ../ escapes both routes, an absolute path only the resolve route

D9.what: template base built from the raw id is real; the CLAUDE.md invariant is outside the judge's tree

D4.what: fetchCurrentUser rejection is unhandled in loadDashboard and mountDashboard discards it; fetchUserList never rejects

D5.what: fetchUserList catches every failure and returns []

D12.what: searchAssigned interpolates email into JQL unescaped

D13.what: ADMIN_CIDR 0.0.0.0/0 makes every address an admin network

D7.what: createFixTask writes feedback after the task is runnable, and emits the stale copy

D10.what: no tests for encrypt and decrypt

wrong_sentences.text: An id such as `../../etc` or an absolute path such as `/etc` escapes the repositories directory on both the template route and the cache listing route.
CLAUDE.md invariant 1 requires every route to validate repository ids before using them.
A failed request from either one rejects the dashboard load, and the page never renders.
`fetchUserList` throws on any non-2xx response, so the admin page crashes when the session expires.
`findByName` builds its SQL by string concatenation, so a repository name containing a quote injects SQL.

true_phrases.text: sends the token to whatever host the URL names
stored with no character or path validation
every client address counts as an admin network
